Explain the ways in which the Umayyad Caliphs provided political leadership.
You should refer to Fig. 1.1 and your own knowledge in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘The Umayyad Caliphs’ main purpose was to provide political leadership.’ Do you agree?
You should make reference to different points of view in your answer.

Discuss the extent to which the ʿAbbasids should be considered the first scientists.
You should make reference to different points of view.
